expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The message says the limit “was 10 minutes until March 2024,” that members on slow mobile connections “were logged out before they confirmed it and lost their picks,” and that 30 minutes was “the shortest that ended those tickets.” It warns that returning to 10 minutes would bring back the problem and asks for confirmation before changing it.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 7; first edit at step None
